footprints.description: APEM ADTS6 / MJTP1230 6 x 6 mm through-hole tactile switch, 4 terminals, 6.5 x 4.5 mm hole grid
footprints.note: adts6-adtsm-ktsc6.pdf p.3 ADTS6**V P.C. LAYOUT: 4X dia 1.00 holes, 6.50 x 4.50; pad 1.7 = 1.7 x drill 1.0 (no land printed); body 6.00 square (top view). 4 terminal numbers from the CIRCUIT figure (adts6-adtsm-ktsc6.pdf p.2: T1-T2 joined on the top line, T3-T4 on the bottom line, the switch between the lines), taken as a top view with each joined pair across the long hole span (the layout prints no numbers): 1 top-left, 2 top-right, 3 bottom-left, 4 bottom-right (slots 1,4,2,3). Shared by MJTP1230/1234 (MJTP1117.pdf p.7 PCB layouts MJTP1230, MJTP1234: 4X dia 1.0, 6.5 x 4.5; bodies .236 (6.0), p.4; 4-terminal schematic p.7 without numbers, numbered the same way) [series using it: ADTS, MJTP]

footprints.description: APEM ADTSA6 right-angle through-hole tactile switch with grounding legs, 2 terminals 4.5 mm apart
footprints.note: AS-ADTSM25KSVB.pdf p.1 (APEM drawing B7606 ADTSA6**V, rotated sheet) P.C. LAYOUT: terminals 1, 2 = the two dia 1.00+-0.05 holes 4.50 apart (row nearer the plunger); the two holes 7.00 apart, 2.50 behind, are ground legs 3, 4 (SCHEMATIC: 3, 4 to ground) and are not drawn; pad 1.7 = 1.7 x drill 1.0. footprints.description: APEM MJTP1236 / MJTP1105T right-angle through-hole tactile switch with grounding legs, 2 terminals 4.5 mm apart
footprints.note: MJTP1117.pdf p.7 PCB layouts MJTP1236 and MJTP1105T (identical): terminals = 2X dia .039 (1.0) holes .177 (4.5) apart; the 2X dia .051 (1.3) holes .276 (7.0) apart, .098 (2.5) above, are the bent frame/ground legs (2-terminal SCHEMATIC p.7) and are not drawn; pad 1.7 = 1.7 x drill 1.0. The layout's dia-1.0 row is the front (plunger) side, at the bottom: p.4 MJTP1236 side view puts the terminal leg .100 [2.54] behind the housing front face and the frame leg 2.5 further back. Body .236 [6.00] wide (front view housing) x 6.5 deep: the depth is not printed, 6.5 scaled from the p.4 side view (2.54 = 70 px; APEM's ADTSA6 drawing of the same layout prints 6.55); terminal row y = 3.25 - 2.54 = 0.71. No terminal numbers printed: pin 1 left, pin 2 right [series using it: MJTP]

footprints.description: APEM (mec) Multimec 3A surface-mount switch (3ASH9), 4 gull-wing pads 12.5 x 7.62 mm
footprints.note: as-3ash9r-45211430.pdf p.3 Recommended PCB layout 'Surface-mount solder pad': pads 2.5 x 1.2, centres 12.5 x 7.62 (same in as-3ash9-44158219.pdf p.1 SMD PCB layout); Circuit diagram p.3: 2 top-left, 1 top-right joined; 4 bottom-left, 3 bottom-right joined; switch between (slots 4,1,3,2), the joined pairs across the 12.5 lead span as in the front views (leads left and right, 14 tip to tip). Body: the bare switch width is not printed (only lead spans 14 and 7.6+-0.5, cap 12.6 and bezel 15.1); 10.1 x 10.1 is DigiKey's size for 3ASH9 and matches the front view scaled against the 14 span [series using it: Multimec 3, Multimec 3A]
